written: 2026-09-27, before any run of this study
question: How large is the representative-day approximation error of flagship A: the difference between the 56-day aging run that resolves 4 days (14-day macro steps, the published flagship) and the run that resolves every day (1-day macro steps)? The flagship records this error as UNKNOWN.
classification: numerical verification of a time-scale approximation against a more resolved run of the SAME model; not validation, not a bound on the error against reality

runs.reference: macro_days = 1 (every one of the 56 days resolved)
runs.everything_else: unchanged: the published flagship build (build_flagship) with only macro_days varied; same providers, parameter set, window size (3600 s), fade model and declared inputs

tolerance.source: REFINEMENT_PEAK_HEAT_REL = 0.02, declared in battery_cooling.py before the flagship's first run
REFINEMENT_TOL['voltage_end_of_discharge'], declared before the flagship's first run
REFINEMENT_TOL['peak_cell_temperature'], declared before the flagship's first run
declared here: one tenth of the 0.01 SOC resolution the flagship's constraint margins are reported at

acceptance.met_if: for every case and every quantity of interest, |QoI(macro_days=14) - QoI(macro_days=1)| <= tolerance
acceptance.not_met_means: the published 4-day representation does not reproduce the fully resolved result within the flagship's own declared tolerances; the measured difference is recorded as the approximation error, not hidden
acceptance.also_reported: the whole sequence 14, 7, 4, 2, 1 per quantity (monotone or not), wall time per run, and whether any run was refused
acceptance.no_change_after_seeing_results: tolerances, cases, sequence and quantities above are fixed; any later reading is labelled post hoc beside the pre-registered outcome

limits_stated_in_advance: the reference (macro_days = 1) still holds the fade constant within each day; its own time-discretization error is not measured by this study
the fade law, the SPM cell model, the quasi-steady cooling rule and every declared input are unchanged and unvalidated; this study measures one approximation of the SAME model
two cases only; the result does not transfer to other duty cycles or climates
